title: Generalized q-Morgan Voyce Polynomials
summary: This study introduces and investigates generalized q-Morgan-Voyce polynomials and their specific cases, including the first and second kinds of q-Morgan-Voyce polynomials, q-Horadam-Morgan-Voyce polynomials, and Fibonacci-type q-Morgan-Voyce polynomials. The generalized q-Morgan-Voyce polynomials are defined by the recurrence relation featuring the specific q-power q^{n-2} and a negative sign, formulated as M_{n}(x,q) = (x+1+q)M_{n-1}(x,q) - q^{n-2}M_{n-2}(x,q) for n >= 2.
